evidence.periodic_water_box: data/water_box_64.extxyz contains 64 waters in a 12.4296 angstrom cubic PBC cell
evidence.stable_central_atom: source ID 126 is fixed across all stages
evidence.exact_cutoff_selection: minimum-image mask contains exactly 83 neighbors within 6.0 angstrom
evidence.bond_and_neighbor_views: stored O-H bonds and stable-ID neighbor vectors are separate semantic layers
evidence.deep_potential_pipeline: renderer shows local coordinates, descriptor, shared atomic network, atomic energies, total energy and differentiation
evidence.real_deepmd_inference: data/dpmd_water_box_results.npz contains one 192-atom DeepMD inference; data/dpmd_eval.json records E=-1007.9069226533904 eV and max|F|=1.2246452541839372 eV/A
evidence.no_fabricated_forces: all numerical force arrows are selected directly from forces_ev_per_angstrom in the retained result

constraints: fixed asymmetric camera and physical scale

transformations: minimum-image neighbor coordinates retain stable IDs
displayed force arrows use one disclosed constant scale

records.reason: the Windows bohr uploader failed before job creation with a temporary-directory access error
records.mitigation: the identical evaluator, water box, and model were run successfully in a time-limited Bohrium sandbox
records.follow_up: none; sandbox output was downloaded, hashed, and the sandbox destroyed

problems.scientific_expression: The initial contract allowed only symbolic output; the final figure is tied to a retained 192-atom DeepMD inference with exact energy and force arrays.
problems.geometry: The first draft used large packed atoms and a faint cutoff surface; atom radii were reduced and the true 3D sphere silhouette plus latitude/longitude mesh was strengthened without changing the camera.
problems.annotations: The first draft put long node labels inside circles and let the center caption cross both safety bands; symbols now sit inside circles and the caption is split within its own panel.
problems.readability: A stage-four heading reached both panel edges and cutoff state briefly reset at stage boundaries; the heading was shortened and sphere, fade, spokes, and forces now transition independently.
problems.submission_quality: The final A4 figure passes strict source and composite checks, while the 16 s video is independently composed and all 384 frames pass the same frame-level gates.

review.action: accepted after two visual-review passes, real DeepMD provenance checks, fixed-camera MatterVis verification, strict A4 QA, and 384-of-384 video-frame QA
